story: Bluff Point State Park is an undeveloped peninsula located between the Poquonnock River and Mumford Cove on Long Island Sound in the town of Groton, Connecticut. The 806 acres encompass a barrier beach, steep cliffs, forested sections, and tidal wetlands.
matters: The Connecticut legislature established Bluff Point as a Coastal Reserve in 1975 to give it the highest possible protection in the State Park system and protect the high number of endangered and threatened species found within the park.
name: Bluff Point State Park
